motivation: The author asked which neurons contribute to solving tasks. EXP-147 read the residual stream at 8 depths; this scans every MLP neuron of 31B at the fix, with selection and test on different tasks.
hypothesis: 64 neurons chosen on one half of the tasks rank a passing run above a failing run of the same task on the other half with AUC 0.70 or more, permutation p < 0.05 with the selection repeated under shuffled labels.
